'''Heavyweight EV Heads''' were head parts for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] made by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. They were reinforced helmets made of malleable cast iron, copper and plastic, equipped with wideangle visual sensors and cybot [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]]. They also furnished with a broadband antenna, a high-frequency [[Binary/Legends|binary]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and speech mimic flap.

These heads had high material durability and weighed around 35 kg. These components were part of the infamous [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]].
